items.question: Any banned phrase present?
items.note: None (lib/learn_hub.test.mjs greps the visible text for the CLAUDE.md list plus coming soon, limited, countdown).

items.question: Is 'free' used at most twice?
items.note: Once: the Free badge on the course card.

items.question: No countdown, no 'limited', no fake counts, no 'coming soon'?
items.note: One card, for the one course that exists in full. No card, line or badge for courses two to four or the Teardown Hour (build prompt §1, §7.1).

items.question: Does the form have six fields and no phone number?
items.note: Not applicable: the hub carries no form. The course page's form was judged in copy-reimbursement-playbook.json.

items.question: Is lesson one readable without the form?
items.note: Not applicable on the hub; the card links straight to the course page, where lesson one is open.

items.question: Does any sentence claim results, clients or testimonials that do not exist?
items.note: The footer states there are no published results. The position line describes what the service does, not what it has done.

items.question: Does every dollar figure trace to facts.json and carry a demo label?
Learn doc §2: one card per built course with badges, the position stated plainly in the headline, under two hundred words?
items.note: Headline: 'The method is public. The execution is the product.' One card with New and Free badges. Visible word count is under two hundred, held by the test.

items.question: Luxury pass: no urgency, no scarcity, no exclamation marks?
items.note: None. The only link in the body is the card itself.
